name: FUN_INTERCO_SOURCE_DOCUMENTS
description: This table contains information of the source documents corresponding to the  source document groups.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for source document.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOC_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the source document group.

columns.name: RECEIVER_ORG_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the receiver organization.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number for the source document.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: The date used for processing the source document.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Allocated transaction amount for the source document.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of source document derived based on status of the transaction.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Allocation percentage of the total transaction amount for the receiver organization.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the source document.

columns.name: PROVIDER_CCID
columns.description: Distribution account code combination of the provider intercompany organization

columns.name: RECEIVER_CCID
columns.description: Distribution account code combination of the receiver intercompany organization

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to identify the reversal of the source document

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for original source document for reversals.

columns.name: REVERSED_SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for reversed source document.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type for conversion from transaction currency.

columns.name: DUE_TO_FROM_CURR_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Basis for currency conversion from transaction currency that's defined for master document.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date of currency conversion from transaction currency to  currency in which funds are received by receiver organization.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: First source document identifier. In most cases, this is mapped to a document header ID.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: Second source document identifier. In most cases, this is mapped to a document line id.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID3
columns.description: Third source document identifier. In most cases, this is mapped to a document distribution id.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID4
columns.description: Fourth source document identifier.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID5
columns.description: Fifth source document identifier.

columns.name: DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document number such as invoice number.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document line number such as invoice line number.

columns.name: DOC_DISTRIBUTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document distribution number such as invoice line distribution number.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_TRX_NUMBER1
columns.description: First additional source document number.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_TRX_NUMBER2
columns.description: Second additional source document number.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the associated source application.

columns.name: DOC_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of source document such as Invoice, Credit Memo, and Debit Memo.

columns.name: DOC_DATE
columns.description: Document or transaction date such as invoice date.

columns.name: DOC_AMOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction amount type such as item, tax, and freight.

columns.name: DOC_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount for the source document.

columns.name: DOC_BU_ID
columns.description: Identifies the business unit of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the supplier of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_LE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the legal entity of the source document.

columns.name: INTERCO_TRX_SOURCE_DOC_ID
columns.description: Identifies the document preparation transaction.

columns.name: INTERCO_TRX_SOURCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Application generated unique transaction number.

columns.name: DOC_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the document is for a reversal transaction.

columns.name: DOC_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the source document.

columns.name: DOC_ASSET_BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the asset book of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the ledger of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the supplier site of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the customer of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the customer account of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_CUST_BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the customer bill to location of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_CCID
columns.description: Account code combination of the source document.

columns.name: REVERSED_DOC_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: Identifies the first associated reversed source document.

columns.name: REVERSED_DOC_REFERENCE_ID2

columns.name: DOC_TYPE

columns.name: DOC_AMOUNT_TYPE
